rationale.oversight-theater: Rubber-Stamp Risk: review exists but lacks authority to change outcomes
rationale.hitl-workflow: Override + execution-boundary control = the human's control surface
rationale.risk-routing: Escalate: risk-based triggers/tiers routing cases to humans
rationale.oversight-explanation: Explain: decision-ready reasons, uncertainty signals for reviewer
rationale.org-governance: operating model, roles, audit logs, KPIs, policy apparatus
rationale.regulatory-compliance: maps to EU AI Act Art.14, ISO 42001, NIST RMF
rationale.design-only: controls+KPIs specified in buildable detail, never implemented/evaluated
rationale.metrics: defines override-rate, escalation-precision, drift-index KPIs; measurand over-reliance
rationale.general-ai: general ML decision automation (credit/hiring/triage), not coding-specific
